title: TRICARE Prime First-Installment Excess Kept for the Installments That Follow
content:
Where the first installment of a new fee-bearing TRICARE Prime enrollment has been paid more than once, part of the excess may stay on the account for the installments that follow:

- where the enrollment pays through an allotment and the account shows payments collected through it, the region keeps **two regular installments** of the excess on the account for the installments that follow;
- where it pays through a recurring card or electronic funds transfer and the account shows payments collected through that method, it keeps **one regular installment**;
- otherwise it keeps **nothing**.

What is kept on the account is not refunded.

## Cases (hypothetical, regular installment 40.39)

| Method on the enrollment | Payments collected through it on the account | Kept |
|---|---|---|
| allotment | yes | 80.78 |
| electronic funds transfer | yes | 40.39 |
| recurring card | none yet | nothing |
| check | - | nothing |
